items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: Robichaud used to come out here. John Robichaud? The violin player? Yeah, the violin player. I mean the violin player, left-handed. Yeah, really good.

ctx.x: Let's see we got the two drummers Did you have any alto horns?

Yeah we had two alto I don't forgot the other alto player He's from John He wrote St Charles You got the Martin You could take Ernest Martin We used to play alto too Ernest Martin We were the leader of the band at that time
